I.ITEM_PRICE, I.COST_PRICE, I.SUPPLY_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER_FLAG, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER,
I.SPOT_FLAG, I.SPOT_DATE_TYPE, I.SPOT_TYPE, I.SPOT_APPLY_GROUP, I.SPOT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.SPOT_START_DATE, I.SPOT_END_DATE, I.SPOT_START_TIME, I.SPOT_END_TIME, I.SPOT_WEEK_DAY,

I.PRIVATE_TYPE,
I.REPRESENTATIVE_ITEM_YN, I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG, I.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, I.MANUFACTURER, I.COLOR, I.WEIGHT, I.SALE_POINT,
I.STOCK_CODE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT, I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY, I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY, I.SALE_QUANTITY,
I.ITEM_ADDITION_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_NAME, I.ITEM_KEYWORD, I.ITEM_NOTICE_CODE, I.TEAM, I.OPENTIME, I.OTHER_FLAG, I.RECOMMEND_FLAG, I.RELATION_ITEM_DISPLAY_TYPE, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_ID, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME, I.DELIVERY_TYPE, I.ITEM_RETURN_FLAG, I.HITS,

I.UPDATED_USER_ID, I.UPDATED_DATE, I.CREATED_USER_ID, I.CREATED_DATE, I.ERP_EXCEPTION_TYPE, I.SHIPMENT_ID, I.SHIPMENT_GROUP_CODE, I.SHIPMENT_RETURN_TYPE, I.SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID, I.SHIPPING_TYPE, I.SHIPPING_GROUP_CODE, I.SHIPPING, I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT, I.SHIPPING_ITEM_COUNT, I.SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE1, I.SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE2, I.SHIPPING_RETURN, S.SELLER_NAME
, IFNULL(( SELECT UL.DISCOUNT_RATE FROM OP_USER_DETAIL UD INNER JOIN OP_USER_LEVEL UL ON UD.LEVEL_ID = UL.LEVEL_ID WHERE UD.USER_ID = #{userId} ), 0) AS USER_LEVEL_DISCOUNT_RATE
FROM OP_CART_SET C INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON C.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2'
C.PARENT_CART_ID = #{parentCartId}
AND C.CART_ID IN
#{cartId}
ORDER BY C.CART_ID DESC

/* saleson.shop.cart.CartMapper.getCartList */ SELECT C.CART_ID, C.SESSION_ID, C.USER_ID, C.ITEM_ID, C.QUANTITY, C.OPTIONS, C.SHIPPING_PAYMENT_TYPE, C.ADDITION_ITEM_FLAG, C.PARENT_ITEM_ID, C.SET_ITEM_FLAG, C.CREATED_DATE AS CART_CREATED_DATE, I.ITEM_ID, I.SELLER_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_SUMMARY, I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_NEW_FLAG, I.ITEM_LABEL, I.ITEM_TYPE1, I.ITEM_TYPE2, I.ITEM_TYPE3, I.ITEM_TYPE4, I.ITEM_TYPE5, I.ITEM_TYPE6, I.ITEM_TYPE7, I.ITEM_TYPE8, I.ITEM_TYPE9, I.ITEM_TYPE10, I.BRAND_ID, I.BRAND, I.SOLD_OUT, I.STOCK_FLAG, I.STOCK_QUANTITY,
I.NONMEMBER_ORDER_TYPE, I.TAX_TYPE, I.COMMISSION_TYPE, I.COMMISSION_RATE, I.PRICE_CRITERIA,
I.ITEM_PRICE, I.COST_PRICE, I.SUPPLY_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER_FLAG, I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER,
I.SPOT_FLAG, I.SPOT_DATE_TYPE, I.SPOT_TYPE, I.SPOT_APPLY_GROUP, I.SPOT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.SPOT_START_DATE, I.SPOT_END_DATE, I.SPOT_START_TIME, I.SPOT_END_TIME, I.SPOT_WEEK_DAY,
I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_FLAG, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_TYPE, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.SELLER_POINT_FLAG,
I.SET_DISCOUNT_TYPE, I.SET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, I.ITEM_IMAGE, I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG, I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE1, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE2, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE3, I.DATA_STATUS_CODE, I.DISPLAY_FLAG, I.COUPON_USE_FLAG, I.NAVER_SHOPPING_ITEM_NAME, I.NAVER_SHOPPING_FLAG, I.NAVER_PAY_FLAG,
I.PRIVATE_TYPE,
(SELECT UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || LOCGOV_NM FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = S.LOCGOV_CODE) AS LOCGOV_NM, S.LOCGOV_CODE, I.REPRESENTATIVE_ITEM_YN, I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG, I.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, I.MANUFACTURER, I.COLOR, I.WEIGHT, I.SALE_POINT,
I.STOCK_CODE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT, I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY, I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY, I.SALE_QUANTITY,
I.ITEM_ADDITION_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_FLAG, I.FREE_GIFT_NAME, I.ITEM_KEYWORD, I.ITEM_NOTICE_CODE, I.TEAM, I.OPENTIME, I.OTHER_FLAG, I.RECOMMEND_FLAG, I.RELATION_ITEM_DISPLAY_TYPE, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_ID, I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME, I.DELIVERY_TYPE, I.ITEM_RETURN_FLAG, I.HITS,
I.MD_ID, I.MD_NAME,
I.SHIPPING_TYPE, I.SHIPPING, I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT,
I.UPDATED_USER_ID, I.UPDATED_DATE, I.CREATED_USER_ID, I.CREATED_DATE, I.ERP_EXCEPTION_TYPE, I.SHIPMENT_ID, I.SHIPMENT_GROUP_CODE, I.SHIPMENT_RETURN_TYPE, I.SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID, I.SHIPPING_TYPE, I.SHIPPING_GROUP_CODE, I.SHIPPING, I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT, I.SHIPPING_ITEM_COUNT, I.SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE1, I.SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE2, I.SHIPPING_RETURN, I.MOBILE_ITEM_YN, S.COMPANY_NAME, S.SELLER_NAME,
C.TEXT_OPTION
, IFNULL(( SELECT UL.DISCOUNT_RATE FROM OP_USER_DETAIL UD INNER JOIN OP_USER_LEVEL UL ON UD.LEVEL_ID = UL.LEVEL_ID WHERE UD.USER_ID = #{userId} ), 0) AS USER_LEVEL_DISCOUNT_RATE
FROM OP_CART C INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON C.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2'
C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'
AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3')
AND I.ITEM_TYPE = #{itemType}
C.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND NONMEMBER_ORDER_TYPE = '1'
AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3')
AND I.ITEM_TYPE = #{itemType}
AND C.CART_ID IN
#{cartId}
ORDER BY C.CART_ID DESC
/* saleson.shop.cart.CartMapper.getCountForUserItemByUserId */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_CART WHERE USER_ID = #{value}

/* saleson.shop.cart.CartMapper.getGuestConvertibleItems */ SELECT * FROM OP_CART C INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON C.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID WHERE C.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3') ORDER BY C.CART_ID DESC
